in_sanskrit.name: Choton
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है Moonlight
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Choton एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। The name Choton is derived from the Sanskrit language and means 'Moonlight'. This name is inspired by the divine light of the moon and signifies the peace, tranquility, and grace that it brings. In Hindu mythology, the moon is considered a symbol of calmness, wisdom, and fertility.
